## Alert.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `tone` :: The meaning of the message. `danger` and `warning` are announced assertively; the rest politely.
- `variant` :: How loudly it speaks: `secondary` is a tinted fill, `outline` a hairline on the page, `primary` a solid block with inverted ink.
- `shape` :: The corner shape.
- `pad` :: The inset around the icon, the message and the actions.
- `gap` :: The space between the icon, the message and the close button.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the title.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the body.
- `title` :: A short heading, set above the message.
- `icon` :: The leading icon. Defaults to one that matches the tone; pass `false` for none.
- `iconSize` :: Text scale of the leading icon and of the close button.
- `dismissible` :: Shows a close button. The alert springs closed when it is pressed.
- `onDismiss` :: Called after the alert has been dismissed.
- `actions` :: Controls drawn below the message — buttons or links.
- `children` :: The message body, set under the title and above the actions.
